issues.claim: source generators for the `[ObservableProperty]` and `[RelayCommand]` attributes ... works with WPF, WinUI, Avalonia and .NET MAUI
issues.problem: The cited introduction page shows ObservableObject, RelayCommand, and support for WinUI 3, UWP, WinForms, WPF, Xamarin and Uno ("and more"). The excerpt names neither the generators nor Avalonia. MAUI is supported only by the first link, where eShop uses the toolkit. Both claims are plausible, since the package targets .NET Standard and the generators exist, but the excerpts do not confirm them.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/communitytoolkit/mvvm/generators/observableproperty link, with matching linkTitles in ru and en. Or soften the text to "works with many UI frameworks, for example WPF, WinUI and .NET MAUI" and drop the claims about the generators and Avalonia.

issues.claim: Какая из частей не должна знать о существовании другой?
issues.problem: The hint is acceptable, but it already points at the key idea that the view model does not know the view. It is close to giving the answer away.
issues.suggestedFix: Make it less direct: "Через что экран получает значения из модели представления, и что происходит при нажатии кнопки?" Update the English hint to match.

issues.claim: bugLineSets: [[21, 31]] and the prompt "Select every line that contains the defect."
issues.problem: The defect is an omission: a missing `OnPropertyChanged(nameof(FullName))` call. The lines 21 and 31 are correct in themselves, because they report FirstName and LastName properly. A candidate could reasonably select the setter bodies (lines 20-21 and 30-31), the setter closing lines, or line 35 (`FullName`), and would be marked wrong. So there is no single unambiguous accepted selection.
issues.suggestedFix: Reword the prompt in ru and en to "Select the lines after which the missing FullName notification must be added". Add the alternative sets [[20,21,30,31]] and [[21,31]] to bugLineSets. Alternatively reword so that the answer is exactly the two notification lines.

issues.claim: A WPF or MAUI window has a label ...
issues.problem: The program is a console sample, and the "window" framing is slightly loose. This does not change the facts.
issues.suggestedFix: Write "A WPF or MAUI screen has a label bound to ...".
